summary: Frontend-only retest of the Living Atlas map (Playwright, 390x844 and 360x640). For each visible place-node, the test tapped the dot centre with mouse.click and checked that the place-sheet title matched the place name. FIXED: every single (non-cluster) dot that is not covered by HUD now opens the correct sheet. At 390 start: caesarea, shiloh, joppa, jericho, hebron, engedi, gaza, nebo. After zoom x2: nazareth, carmel, shechem, shiloh, bethel, jericho, qumran, hebron, engedi, nebo. Revelation: all 8 (patmos plus the 7 churches). No dot opened the wrong sheet. FIXED: the revelation map shows all 8 dots at start. FIXED: settings back on a direct /settings visit goes to '/' with no GO_BACK error. FIXED: tora, acts, prophets and letters use cover fit (relief is 780px tall, the full map height). Clouds and shimmer only render when there is no relief. Regression checks pass: place-art and place-label taps (Jerusalem, Jericho, Kapernaum art), all 7 map-filter-* change the visible marker counts, verse-of-day hide/show, Studienreise cards plus study-open-map and study-back-to-cards, map-motion Aus/An, no page errors. STILL BROKEN (CRITICAL): the Jerusalem cluster dot (+2) at start cannot be tapped (tested at 390 and 360). RCA: the wrapper Animated.View of the hidden member Bethlehem (opacity 0, 44x44) still has computed pointer-events:auto, so it catches the tap. The 'box-none' style does not turn into pointer-events:none on web. 9 hidden wrappers are affected at start (dan, hazor, megiddo, samaria, bethel, bethlehem, qumran, beersheba, kadesh). Setting pointer-events:none on hidden wrappers in the browser made the Jerusalem tap open the Jerusalem sheet. NEW HIGH: the cover-fit wide maps start centred on empty areas. Prophets shows 0 places, acts 1 (Athens), tora 1 (Jericho), letters 3 dots with no labels. Overview start does not really leave room for the header and verse card: the map is clamped at its top edge, so Kapernaum, Berg Karmel and Nazareth stay under the verse-of-day card at 390. At 360x640 it is worse: only Jerusalem down to the Negev is visible, and Caesarea, Joppe and Sichem are covered too. Revelation shows dots but no church names at start. No deprecated Expo packages found.

ui_bugs.issue: A hidden marker (shown=false, opacity 0) keeps a 44x44 wrapper with computed pointer-events:auto. Its style pointerEvents:'box-none' on Animated.View does not take effect on web: every wrapper computes to 'auto'. The hidden wrapper sits above the visible neighbouring dot in DOM order and takes the tap. Reproduced on the Jerusalem cluster at start: elementFromPoint returns place-node-bethlehem's hidden wrapper, no pointer events reach the place-node-jerusalem button, and no sheet opens (390x844 and 360x640). Hidden wrappers still catching taps at start: dan, hazor, megiddo, samaria, bethel, bethlehem, qumran, beersheba, kadesh. Fix: pointerEvents: shown ? 'box-none' : 'none' on the wrapper (MapPlaceMarker.tsx:120), or pass pointerEvents as a prop. Simulated in the browser: Jerusalem then opens correctly.

ui_bugs.component: Wide theme maps initial view (cover fit)
ui_bugs.issue: Cover fit fills the height, but with initial=undefined the view starts at the map centre. Visible place nodes at start (390x844): prophets 0/12 (only empty desert and route ends), acts 1/16, tora 1/21, letters 3/9 with no labels. The initial view should be centred on placesBox(map) or the routes.

padTop includes the verse card (VerseOfDay sits inside the top View), but clampY keeps the map's top edge at y=0, so the initial box cannot be shifted below the HUD. At 390x844, Kapernaum, Berg Karmel and the Nazareth cluster are under verse-of-day (elementFromPoint hits verse-of-day-text). At 360x640, Kapernaum, Karmel, Caesarea, Sichem and Joppe are under the chips and verse card, and the visible map is mostly Negev and Edom. Allow overscroll or a top offset equal to padTop in the clamp, or start the verse card collapsed on small screens.

All 8 dots are visible and tappable, but no place-label is visible at start. The churches have no events, so the tier-2 'quiet' rule (zoom<1.2, events<2) hides their names. Users see 8 unnamed dots on 'Die sieben Gemeinden'.

The aria-label of a cluster says '... antippen zum Vergrößern', but the main map passes no onCluster, so a tap opens the head place's sheet (Sichem cluster opens the Sichem sheet). The label and the behaviour do not match.

issues: The map is only a 390x372 band (y 204-576) with an empty teal area below it. At 360x640, Pergamon and Thyatira start under the verse card.
The 'Zur Themenübersicht' button overlaps the world cards ('Die vier Evangelien', 'Gleichnisse Jesu'). The header and verse card cover the top third of the map.

action_items: CRITICAL: MapPlaceMarker.tsx:120: set the wrapper to pointerEvents: shown ? 'box-none' : 'none' (on web 'box-none' in the Animated.View style computes to 'auto'). Retest the Jerusalem cluster dot at start.
HIGH: give the wide maps (tora, acts, prophets, letters) an initial view centred on placesBox(map) or the route bounds when cover fit is used.

HIGH: let the overview start box really clear the header and verse card: allow the map top to sit below padTop in clampY, or collapse the verse card by default on short screens. Kapernaum and Galilee are hidden at 390 and 360.
MEDIUM: show the church names on the revelation map at start (exempt sparse maps from the 'quiet' label rule).
LOW: make the cluster aria-label match the behaviour (opens a sheet, does not zoom), or pass onCluster to zoom.
critical_code_review_comments: GeoMap.tsx:110 promotes tier 3 to tier 2 on sparse maps, but the 'quiet' rule at GeoMap.tsx:135 still hides those labels below zoom 1.2.
index.tsx:82 cover fit has no initial box for themed maps (initial is only set for the overview).
MapPlaceMarker: a disabled Pressable inside a 'box-none' wrapper is not enough on react-native-web. The wrapper needs pointer-events:none while hidden.

success_rate.frontend: ~80% (all single dots, revelation dots, settings back and regression checks pass; cluster dot blocked, wide-map and overview initial views poor)

context_for_next_testing_agent: Onboarding: click 'Überspringen' then 'Bibel entdecken'. The tap check uses the dot centre with mouse.click and compares the place-sheet title with the aria-label name (helper JS in iter33_helpers.py). For the Jerusalem cluster at start, elementFromPoint at the centre returns the hidden wrapper of place-node-bethlehem (parent of the button). Check getComputedStyle(wrapper).pointerEvents on wrappers whose opacity is < 0.5. To measure the wide-map initial view, use the atlas-relief bounding rect and count place-node elements with opacity > 0.5 and y between 150 and 640.
rca_of_issue: Hidden markers are still hit-testable: on react-native-web the Animated.View wrapper with style pointerEvents 'box-none' computes to pointer-events:auto, and disabled={!shown} only disables the inner Pressable. The 44x44 transparent wrapper still catches the click and the event never reaches the visible neighbour. Mitigation: pointerEvents 'none' when !shown. Verified by injecting it in the browser.
